featured_reviews.review_text:
A Heavenly Experience at Ice Cream Garden, Vasai

I recently visited Ice Cream Garden in Vasai, and I must say, it was one of the best ice cream experiences I’ve ever had! The flavors they offer are truly exceptional. I’ve never had such delicious, natural ice creams before. The range of flavors is beyond what I ever imagined possible!

During my visit around Sankranti, they had a special Til Gud flavor, which was absolutely amazing, and also a Modak flavor that captured the festive essence perfectly. Apart from these, I also tried some of their regular flavors like Cheeku, Lotus Biscoff, Hazelnut, Guava, and many more – each one was better than the last.

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Over a span of 3 days, we had the pleasure to taste a couple of ice cream flavours. Everything sold here comes in small and large size.

Butterscotch - it was ok. The butterscotch flavor was mild compared to amul.
American Dry Fruit - For those who appreciate the richness of dry fruits, this is a worthwhile choice.
Rajbhog - Tasted great
Black Currant - My favorite flavor here
Cold Coco - For all the chocolate enthusiasts out there, this is an absolute must-try. It offers a twist on traditional chocolate milk.

On the other hand, Spl Srinath flavour did not meet my expectations. Its peculiar sweetness was not appealing, and I will not be ordering it again.
Mawa Malai was unavailable during our visit, but we hope to try it in the future.

The service was prompt and they are always smiling and willing to suggest flavors based on your likes. The faloodas are pretty filling.

featured_reviews.name: mayur panchbhai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the misfortune of trying the American Dry Fruit Falloda and Kesar Pista Falloda at This place , and let me tell you, it was a major letdown. Both faloodas were utterly tasteless, a shocking betrayal of this typically delightful dessert.

The American Dry Fruit Falloda, which promised a symphony of textures and flavors, was a bland mess. The сухофрукты (dried fruits) were chewy and flavorless, the ice cream tasted artificial, and the syrup lacked any sweetness or depth. The Kesar Pista Falloda wasn't much better. The rosewater was overpowering, drowning out any hint of saffron or pistachio. It was like drinking perfume, not a falloda.

I left American Dry Fruit Falloda feeling cheated and disappointed. It was a total waste of money and calories. If you're looking for a delicious and authentic falloda experience, avoid this place like the plague. There are plenty of other options in Vasai-Virar that will satisfy your sweet tooth without assaulting your senses.

featured_reviews.review_text: The best falooda and milkshake in town for a reasonable price. Badaam milkshake is not to be missed. Rose falooda is also made very well and taste is amazing. As per Indian standards, always go for half glass of any ordered drink for best value. Even the kulfi stick and ice cream is worth trying. A little issue with the place around to stand and enjoy the drinks but manageable.
